_comment: Tool-call aliases read by .claude/hooks/alias.sh. Rules are checked in order; first match wins. action 'rewrite' (Bash only): regex-replace the command. action 'block': deny with message. 'match' is an optional regex on the call's input (JSON-escaped, so keep patterns free of double quotes).

aliases.name: block-destructive-bash
aliases.message: Destructive shell command blocked by the repo's alias router (.claude/tool-aliases.json). Use a non-destructive form, or ask the user to run it.
